title: Spring Hill Nursery — How Roses are Sized and Graded

common.applies_to: Bush rose; establishment signals when planting date is unknown
common.preserved_uncertainty: A commercial nursery grading standard (what is sold as new stock), not horticultural research on post-planting establishment.

content.identity: Spring Hill Nursery, "How Roses are Sized and Graded," https://springhillnursery.com/pages/about_rose_grading, accessed during FRD-BUSHROSE-RECENTPLANT-02 research
content.relevance: Establishes the roughly-three-cane baseline for a newly purchased Grade #1 rose, the anchor point AF-2's cane-count signal is built from.
